title: Choose the mode-specific export route
when: Before moving or deleting the universe containing strategy and work
need: Export is a self-contained universe archive. Local, self-host HTTPS and hosted coordinated download have distinct authority paths. Use the active mode; do not obtain a remote DSN as a shortcut. Hosted Download archive starts a fenced export that pauses only the source tenant and produces the dump and receipt from one snapshot. A failed or interrupted export automatically restarts the source; a completed export stays paused across restarts until an organization admin explicitly resumes it. No dashboard Resume control exists yet. Export completion does not establish destination acceptance or a storage transfer.
surface: Universe settings documentation; uninstall backup choice; universe export help routes by mode.
